title: Component-Weighted Centroid Search for Exact Incremental BPE
abstract: arXiv:2609.40016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Exact incremental BPE maintains the canonical tokenization state after every appended byte. The recent algorithm of Jiang and Gong (2026) does this in $O(\log^2 t)$ worst-case time, where $t$ is the maximum canonical token length. Its centroid search visits $O(\log t)$ components and can pay another $O(\log t)$ for ordered point location at each one. Within Jiang and Gong's normalized/proper merge-stage model, we change only that local search. Each interval is weighted by the size of the recursive component it selects, so a move from size $m$ to size $m'$ costs $O(1+\log(m/m'))$. These charges telescope, giving $O(\log t)$ time per append and $O(n\log t)$ over an $n$-byte stream, with the same BPE semantics and asymptotic space. We also construct a normalized proper BPE family over a fixed alphabet where count-balanced search uses $\Theta(\log^2 t)$ probes on a reachable update, while the weighted search uses $\Theta(\log t)$. translated_title: 面向精确增量BPE的组件加权质心搜索
translated_abstract: 精确增量BPE要求在每次追加字节后都维护规范分词状态。Jiang和Gong（2026）最近的算法以O(log² t)的最坏情况时间实现这一点，其中t是最大规范词元长度。其质心搜索需要访问O(log t)个组件，并且可能在每个组件上还需为有序点定位额外支付O(log t)。在Jiang和Gong的规范化/适当合并阶段模型内，我们仅修改了这一局部搜索环节。每个区间按其选中的递归组件大小进行加权，使得从大小m移动到大小m′的代价为O(1+log(m/m′))。这些代价可以裂项相消，从而使每次字节追加的时间为O(log t)，n字节流的总时间为O(n log t)，同时保持相同的BPE语义和渐近空间。我们还在固定字母表上构造了一族规范化适当BPE实例，证明计数平衡搜索在可达更新上需要Θ(log² t)次探测，而加权搜索仅需Θ(log t)。
tldr: 该论文提出组件加权质心搜索，通过按所选递归组件大小为区间加权使搜索代价可裂项相消，将精确增量BPE每次字节追加的最坏时间复杂度从O(log² t)改进至O(log t)，并构造实例证明该改进在可达更新上是最优的。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a component-weighted centroid search that weights each interval by the size of its selected recursive component so the costs telescope, improving the worst-case time per byte append in exact incremental BPE from O(log² t) to O(log t), and constructs a BPE family proving this bound is tight for reachable updates.
